name: Astera Labs
description: Astera Labs sells chips, boards and modules that move data between processors, memory, storage and networks inside AI and cloud data centers: Aries PCIe/CXL retimers, Taurus ethernet cable modules, Leo CXL memory controllers and Scorpio fabric switches, all running its COSMOS management software. Customers are hyperscalers, AI-accelerator makers and system OEMs, reached mostly through distributors and the manufacturing partners that build the customers' systems. Revenue more than doubled to $852.5M in 2025 and doubled again year on year in Q2 2026, and it is very concentrated: in 2025 one end customer was more than 70 percent of revenue and the top three about 86 percent.

hq.note: Corporate headquarters leases about 154,231 sq ft in San Jose, lease to November 2032 (FY2025 10-K Item 2)

employees.note: 756 full-time employees: 527 North America, 208 Asia, 21 Europe (FY2025 10-K); plus contractors

businessLines.name: Aries PCIe/CXL Smart DSP Retimers and Smart Cable Modules
businessLines.how: Chips and modules sold per unit on purchase orders for specific products; revenue follows hyperscaler and AI-server build-outs.
businessLines.description: Retimer chips and cable modules that clean up and extend high-speed PCIe/CXL signals between processors, storage and network controllers.

businessLines.name: Scorpio Smart Fabric Switches
businessLines.how: Switch chips sold per unit, designed in to hyperscaler AI platforms.
businessLines.description: PCIe switches (P-Series for Gen 6 head-node connectivity; X-Series) for AI platforms.

businessLines.name: Taurus Ethernet Smart Cable Modules
businessLines.how: Modules sold per unit on purchase orders.
businessLines.description: Modules that extend ethernet reach over copper for rack-level server-to-switch links.

businessLines.name: Leo CXL Memory Connectivity Controllers
businessLines.how: Chips and boards sold per unit.
businessLines.description: Controllers that let processors expand, share and pool DRAM over CXL links.

businessLines.name: COSMOS software suite
businessLines.how: Embedded in the hardware; no separate revenue is reported.
businessLines.description: Link, fleet and reliability management software embedded in the products.
